title: The Fall Harvest Plant Board
seo_title: Vegan Fall Charcuterie Board for 6–8: Shopping List & Plan
description: A plant-based fall harvest board for 6–8: aged cashew cheese, pumpkin seed dip, roasted delicata squash, apples, figs and candied pecans. 100% vegan.
hook: Every autumn flavour on a board with no dairy and no meat, and nobody at the table notices what's missing.
why: Fall flavour is mostly caramel, spice and earthy sweetness, and none of that needs meat or dairy. Roasting the delicata squash browns its sugars, and an aged, Gouda-style cashew cheese gives the same savoury depth an aged dairy cheese would.

Pumpkin seeds show up twice, blended into the dip and toasted whole, for creaminess and crunch from one ingredient. Apple and whole-grain mustard bring the acid, and fig jam and candied pecans the sweetness.

timeline.what: Roast the squash rings at 400°F for 20 minutes.
Take out the cashew cheese; make the pumpkin seed dip.
Slice the apple; fill the bowls; let the squash cool.
Arrange the crackers; add the dried fruit.
Add rosemary and thyme; serve the squash warm.

faq.a: Yes. Every item is plant-based. Check labels on the crackers and candied pecans, which sometimes contain butter or honey.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 16–18 inch board.

faq.q: Where do I find aged cashew cheese?
faq.a: Well-stocked grocery stores carry cultured cashew cheeses near the specialty cheese. A cashew brie also works.
